findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info, list_services, submit_contact_request · Private data: get_company_info, submit_contact_request, request_free_audit · Public sink: get_company_info, submit_contact_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info, list_services, submit_contact_request · Private data: get_company_info, submit_contact_request, request_free_audit · Public sink: get_company_info, submit_contact_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
